title: AI solved the biggest maths problem of all – and created a bigger one
headline: Anthropic Claude and the Riemann hypothesis verification challenge
summary: Anthropic's Claude AI model reportedly proved the Riemann hypothesis, generating 250,000 pages of output. However, the commentary questions the validity of proofs that cannot be understood or verified by humans.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying AI for complex technical or analytical tasks must grapple with the assurance challenge of verifying machine-generated outputs that exceed human readability.

quotes.text: Anthropic’s Claude may have proved the mother of all problems, the Riemann hypothesis, but if no human can understand 250,000 pages of slop, is it actually real?
